title: Sandwave Variable Voltage 510 Battery
description:
Experience effortless vaping with Sandwave. Featuring advanced draw-to-activate technology, Sandwave eliminates the need for button taps, providing a seamless and hassle-free experience. Simply inhale, and Sandwave instantly responds, transforming your favourite oil into rich, smooth vapour bursting with flavour! Designed with a user-friendly slide switch, it offers three temperature settings tailored to enhance both flavour and potency.

Product Features:

- 3 temperature settings via slide switch (2.8V/3.2V/3.6V)

- Drop-in magnetic connection compatible with 510-thread cartridges

- LED function indicator

- Inhale activated

- USB-C charging

- Satisfying silicone wave grip

What’s Included:
1 x Sandwave Variable Voltage 510 Battery
2 x Magnetic Connectors
1 x USB-C Charging Cable
1 x User Manual
